# DSH Plugins Collection

A curated list of **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** plugins. DeepSeek Harness is an
agent harness where *"e

verything is a plugin"*, and the community has built a
large ecosystem of extensions.
This list contains **621 repositories** — every public repository.
